jd_text:
Intern 1
Job Title: Model-Based Design (MBD) Intern - On-Board Charger
Department: Model Based Design
Job Summary:
Join our Engineering Team as an intern to assist in designing and developing On-Board Charger
(OBC) simulations and control logic for electric vehicles. Gain hands-on experience in power
electronics, control systems, and embedded systems while contributing to real-world EV
charging projects.
Key Responsibilities:
 Develop and validate OBC simulation models.
 Assist in control algorithm OBC design and implementation.
 Support embedded software development and testing.
 Perform data analysis, debugging, and performance evaluation.
 Participate in hardware bring-up and laboratory testing.
 Prepare technical documentation and reports.
Requirements:
 Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Control
Systems, Embedded Systems, or related fields.
 Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink.
 Basic knowledge of embedded C programming.
 Understanding of control systems and power electronics fundamentals.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills:
 Model-Based Design (MBD) in MATLAB/Simulink and Stateflow
 Embedded systems development
 Hardware testing and validation

Full Stack Developer Intern
0–1 Year Experience · Intern · Engineering
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a motivated Full Stack Developer Intern to join our engineering team. You will
work across the stack, contributing to front-end interfaces, back-end services, and internal
tooling. This is a hands-on role where you will work on real problems and be expected to take
ownership of your work. We value problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn over
technical familiarity alone.
Experience Type Team Location
0–1 Year Intern Engineering On-site
WHAT YOU’LL DO
• Identify inefficiencies in existing workflows and contribute to improving or replacing them
• Build and maintain internal tools, dashboards, and automations that help the team work
more effectively
• Translate unclear or open-ended problems into structured technical solutions
• Collaborate with team members to understand their needs and deliver software that
addresses them
• Contribute to the full development lifecycle from scoping and design through to
deployment
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-haves:
• Ability to think through systems, map workflows, and break down problems logically
• Foundational knowledge of full stack web development
• Understanding of REST APIs — how they work and how to use them
• Basic familiarity with databases (SQL or NoSQL)
• Comfortable using Git for version control
• Clear written and verbal communication
Nice to have — tech stack:
Familiarity with any of the following is a plus:
Python JavaScript TypeScript React
Flask FastAPI Docker Kubernetes
AWS
WHAT YOU GET
• Competitive compensation
• Learning and development opportunities
• Collaborative team environment
• Exposure to real-world engineering problems and ownership from day one
--- END OF DOCUMENT ---

• Collaborate with team members to understand their needs and deliver software that

• Contribute to the full development lifecycle from scoping and design through to

• Competitive compensation
• Learning and development opportunities
• Collaborative team environment
• Exposure to real-world engineering problems and ownership from day one
